verdict.rationale: Deel's own marketing says it runs compliant payroll for employees with automated compliance, which is the core capability. However, the evidence is framed only at the country level (150+ countries) and never mentions US states, state tax registrations, or per-state withholding. missing for 10: documented multi-state payroll support, state tax registration handling, per-state withholding calculation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run payroll for employees across multiple states with the right registrations and withholdings per state

citations.quote: Run accurate, compliant payroll for employees, contractors, and EOR workers across 150+ countries with unified data, automated compliance, and real-time cost visibility.
Pay every worker type, in every country, from one platform.
